title: www.avoltaworld.com
description: Avolta is a global retail company specializing in convenience stores and travel retail operations. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Switzerland, the company maintains a significant international presence across Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific, Middle East, and South America. Avolta operates extensive retail networks in airports, transportation hubs, and commercial centers, offering consumers convenient shopping experiences with a diverse range of products and services. The company leverages mobile applications and digital solutions to enhance customer engagement while maintaining physical retail locations worldwide.
